title: Lesson 1 - Mapping Business Requirements and KPIs to Agentforce Sales Capabilities
description: Given business requirements, metrics, key performance indicators, or business challenges, determine the optimal solution in Agentforce Sales.

questions.question: A sales operations team reports that reps fail to work a consistent sequence of calls and emails, and managers cannot see whether the sequence was followed. Which Agentforce Sales capability addresses this?
options: Einstein Lead Scoring to rank the leads
Sales Engagement cadences worked from work queues
Opportunity Forecasting to project the pipeline
Data Cloud ingestion to unify the records
questions.explanation: Sales Engagement is the cadence and work queue feature built for exactly this follow-up consistency problem, while the other options target scoring, forecasting, or data, none of which drive a rep's step sequence.

questions.question: A VP asks for a feature that predicts which open opportunities are most likely to close so reps can prioritize their day. Which layer is the correct choice?
options: An Agentforce agent topic built in Agent Builder
questions.explanation: The verb is predict, and Einstein Opportunity Scoring ranks opportunities from a trained model, whereas an agent reasons and acts rather than scoring.

questions.question: Partners need to register deals and see only their own opportunities in a branded site. What do you recommend?
options: Quip document sharing on each opportunity
Territory assignment rules on the account
An Experience Cloud partner site with sharing rules
questions.explanation: A branded external portal for partners is an Experience Cloud partner site, since a report, a Quip document, or a territory rule never provides an external login surface.
